message.content: Based on the information provided, Wolfgang did indeed inform Li Hua about his upcoming business trip to Hong Kong, mentioning that he would be "off to Hong Kong for a couple of days next week." Subsequently, he shared plans for his first day in the city, including potential activities like visiting Victoria Peak and trying dim sum in Mong Kok. This indicates that Wolfgang arrived in Hong Kong after informing Li Hua about his trip. The details of his travel and initial impressions of the city align with him having already made the trip.
